relationship_types.depends_on: Source requires target for validity or interpretation.
relationship_types.supports: Source provides governed support for target within declared limits.
relationship_types.contradicts: Source conflicts with target or exposes an inconsistency.
relationship_types.supersedes: Source replaces target while preserving lineage.
relationship_types.refines: Source narrows, clarifies, or improves target.
relationship_types.aliases: Source is a surface or symbolic variant of target.
relationship_types.blocks: Source prevents promotion or claim elevation of target.
relationship_types.tests: Source is an empirical or simulation test of target.

relationship_review_rules.name: support_requires_evidence_v1
relationship_review_rules.statement: A supports relationship requires a governed evidence path, proof path, theorem binding, or empirical result package.

relationship_review_rules.name: contradiction_requires_review_v1
relationship_review_rules.statement: A contradicts relationship must trigger contradiction or anomaly review before dependent claims remain active.

relationship_review_rules.name: supersession_requires_lineage_v1
relationship_review_rules.statement: A supersedes relationship must preserve the superseded object path and reason for replacement.
